def transform(grid, box_color=5, cycle=(2,5,0,5)):
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==box_color]
    t,l=min(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts)
    b,r=max(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    t,b,l,r=t+1,b-1,l+1,r-1
    k=0
    while b-t+1>=3 and r-l+1>=3:
        c=cycle[k%4]
        for j in range(l,r+1): g[t][j]=c; g[b][j]=c
        for i in range(t,b+1): g[i][l]=c; g[i][r]=c
        t+=1;b-=1;l+=1;r-=1;k+=1
    if b-t+1==2 and r-l+1==2:
        g[t][l]=cycle[k%4]; g[t][r]=cycle[k%4]; g[b][l]=cycle[k%4]; g[b][r]=cycle[k%4]
    return g

def find_box(grid, color=5):
    """The bounding box (top, left, bottom, right) of all cells of a color."""
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]

def draw_ring(grid, top, left, bottom, right, color):
    """Draw a 1-cell-thick rectangular ring on a copy of the grid."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for j in range(left, right+1):
        g[top][j]=color; g[bottom][j]=color
    for i in range(top, bottom+1):
        g[i][left]=color; g[i][right]=color
    return g

def nested_box_fill(grid, box_color=5, cycle=(2,5,0,5)):
    """Inside the box of box_color, draw nested 1-thick rings cycling through cycle, fill a leftover 2x2 center with the next color, leave a 1x1 center unchanged."""
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==box_color]
    t,l=min(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts)
    b,r=max(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    t,b,l,r=t+1,b-1,l+1,r-1
    k=0
    while b-t+1>=3 and r-l+1>=3:
        c=cycle[k%len(cycle)]
        for j in range(l,r+1): g[t][j]=c; g[b][j]=c
        for i in range(t,b+1): g[i][l]=c; g[i][r]=c
        t+=1;b-=1;l+=1;r-=1;k+=1

        for i in (t,b):
            for j in (l,r): g[i][j]=c
    return g

def concentric_fill(grid, box_color=5, colors=(2,5), stop_below=5):
    """Inside the box of box_color, draw nested 1-thick rings cycling through colors while the region is at least stop_below wide."""
